dedupe_keys.name: bright multimodal optical and sar building damage assessment dataset

description: BRIGHT is an open benchmark of paired pre-event optical and post-event synthetic aperture radar and optical imagery with building damage labels, built so that AI damage mapping can work in all weather, day and night. It covers five types of natural disasters and two types of human-made disasters across 14 regions worldwide, with a focus on developing countries, in about 4,200 image pairs at 0.3 to 1 m resolution containing over 380,000 building instances. It was assembled by H. Chen, J. Song, O. Dietrich, C. Broni-Bediako, W. Xuan, J. Wang, X. Shao, Y. Wei and co-authors, published in Earth System Science Data in November 2025, and used as the official dataset for the 2025 IEEE GRSS Data Fusion Contest and a CVPR 2026 workshop challenge. The data (version 2.4, May 2026, about 25.6 GB) are available for free download from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0, with code and pretrained models on GitHub. Caveats: some optical pre-event images for Ukraine, Myanmar and Mexico must be fetched separately following the authors' instructions, and labels cover buildings only. It supports rapid post-event damage mapping for response and recovery planning; a related record is the HayWired lifeline exposure dataset.
